mapper.select:
-- 강아지 필터 정보 SELECT dm.dog_match_id, dm.dog_id, dm.breed_gbn_cd, dm.is_mix, dm.weight, dm.weight_category, dm.dog_type_code_gbn_cd, dm.walk_start_time, dm.walk_end_time, dm.walk_days, dm.blood_test_certified, dm.vaccination_certified, dm.health_record_certified, dm.match_type,
GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g1.gubn_name) AS dog_personal, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g2.gubn_name) AS dog_play,
CONCAT( IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_1, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_2, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_3, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_4, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_5, '') ) AS dog_personal_gbn_cd,
CONCAT( IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_1, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_2, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_3, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_4, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_5, '') ) AS dog_play_gbn_cd,
g3.gubn_name AS breed,
g4.gubn_name AS dog_type
FROM tbl_dog_match dm LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn g1 ON g1.group_code = 'dog_personal_code' AND (g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_1 OR g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_2 OR g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_3 OR g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_4 OR g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_5) LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn g2 ON g2.group_code = 'dog_play_code' AND (g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_1 OR g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_2 OR g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_3 OR g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_4 OR g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_5) -- breed_code에 해당하는 gubn_name을 가져오는 조인 LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn g3 ON g3.group_code = 'breed_code' AND g3.gubn_code = dm.breed_gbn_cd LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn g4 ON g4.group_code = 'dog_type_code' AND g4.gubn_code = dm.dog_type_code_gbn_cd WHERE dm.dog_id = #{dogId} AND dm.match_type = #{matchType} GROUP BY dm.dog_id;

-- 강아지 매칭 리스트 SELECT d.*, -- breed 한글명 가져오기 (단일 행 보장) (SELECT g.gubn_name FROM tbl_gubn g WHERE g.group_code = 'breed_code' AND g.gubn_code = d.breed LIMIT 1) AS breed_name,
-- 사용자 주소 가져오기 (단일 행 보장) (SELECT u.address FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.username = d.username LIMIT 1) AS address,
-- 최종 match_score 계산 (7 * (CASE WHEN m.weight_category = 'U' AND d.weight >= m.weight - 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 7 * (CASE WHEN d.personality_type = m.dog_type_code_gbn_cd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_dog_personal p WHERE p.dog_id = d.dog_id AND p.dog_personal_gbn_cd IN (m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_1, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_2, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_3, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_4, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_5)) + 2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_dog_play pl WHERE pl.dog_id = d.dog_id AND pl.dog_play_gbn_cd IN (m.dog_play_gbn_cd_1, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_2, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_3, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_4, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_5)) + 10 * (CASE WHEN d.walk_start_time = m.walk_start_time AND d.walk_end_time = m.walk_end_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + COALESCE(LENGTH(d.walk_days) - LENGTH(REPLACE(d.walk_days, ',', '')) + 1, 0) + CASE WHEN ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, d.walk_start_time, m.walk_start_time)) <= 30 THEN 10 WHEN ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, d.walk_start_time, m.walk_start_time)) <= 60 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, d.walk_end_time, m.walk_end_time)) <= 30 THEN 10 WHEN ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, d.walk_end_time, m.walk_end_time)) <= 60 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END ) AS match_score,
CONCAT( CASE WHEN d.breed = m.breed_gbn_cd THEN '품종' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN d.is_mix = m.is_mix THEN ',믹스여부' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN m.weight_category = 'U' AND d.weight >= m.weight - 1 THEN ',체중' WHEN m.weight_category = 'D' AND d.weight <= m.weight + 1 THEN ',체중' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN d.personality_type = m.dog_type_code_gbn_cd THEN ',성격유형' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_dog_personal p WHERE p.dog_id = d.dog_id AND p.dog_personal_gbn_cd IN (m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_1, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_2, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_3, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_4, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_5)) > 0 THEN ',성격' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_dog_play pl WHERE pl.dog_id = d.dog_id AND pl.dog_play_gbn_cd IN (m.dog_play_gbn_cd_1, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_2, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_3, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_4, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_5)) > 0 THEN ',놀이' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, d.walk_start_time, m.walk_start_time)) <= 60 OR ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, d.walk_end_time, m.walk_end_time)) <= 60) THEN ',산책시간' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (LENGTH(d.walk_days) - LENGTH(REPLACE(d.walk_days, ',', '')) + 1) > 0 THEN ',산책요일' ELSE '' END ) AS matched_criteria
FROM tbl_dogs d JOIN tbl_dog_match m ON m.dog_id = #{dogId} -- 강아지 ID WHERE (d.breed = m.breed_gbn_cd OR m.breed_gbn_cd IS NULL) AND (m.is_mix = 'N' AND d.is_mix = 'N' OR m.is_mix = 'Y') AND d.username <> #{username} ORDER BY match_score DESC, RAND() LIMIT 20;
